properties.description: Child pipeline called by PL_D365_Writeback once per entity. Reads pending requests from VW_D365_REQUESTS and dispatches each to the Dataverse Web API. Authenticates via the factory managed identity (Application User in D365) -- no OAuth token is required or passed in. A successful POST's GUID is captured into XREF via SP_XREF_CAPTURE_D365_ID before being logged as a success; a POST that succeeds but whose XREF capture fails is logged as XREF_CAPTURE_FAILED, never a plain success. Every outcome is logged via SP_D365_LOG_RESPONSE, including a best-effort parse of the real HTTP status out of a failed WebActivity error message.

activities.name: LKP_GetRequests
activities.description: Fetches pending writeback requests. DEV Event batch defaults to one request unless TestRowsPerCombo specifies a larger limit; the Event Type batch remains capped at one.

query.value:
SELECT
    pipeline_id,
    source_instance,
    entity_id,
    golden_record_id,
    target_guid,
    http_method,
    request_url,
    request_body,
    payload_md5@{if(equals(pipeline().parameters.PipelineId, 'D365_EVENT_BATCH'), ', re_event_id, re_event_ref, planned_d365_guid', if(equals(pipeline().parameters.PipelineId, 'D365_EVENTTYPE_BATCH'), ', re_event_type, request_body:"mha_eventtypeid"::VARCHAR AS planned_d365_guid', ''))}
FROM @{if(equals(pipeline().parameters.PipelineId, 'D365_HISTORICACTIVITY_PILOT'), 'INTEGRATION_DB.DYNAMICS.VW_D365_HISTORICACTIVITY_PILOT_REQUESTS_DEV', if(equals(pipeline().parameters.PipelineId, 'D365_TRIBUTE_PILOT'), 'INTEGRATION_DB.DYNAMICS.VW_D365_TRIBUTE_PILOT_REQUESTS_DEV', if(equals(pipeline().parameters.PipelineId, 'D365_PACKAGE_CHAIN_PILOT'), 'INTEGRATION_DB.DYNAMICS.VW_D365_PACKAGE_CHAIN_PILOT_REQUESTS_DEV', if(equals(pipeline().parameters.PipelineId, 'D365_CANVASSER_PILOT'), 'INTEGRATION_DB.DYNAMICS.VW_D365_CANVASSER_PILOT_REQUESTS_DEV', if(equals(pipeline().parameters.PipelineId, 'D365_TAXDECLARATION_PILOT'), 'INTEGRATION_DB.DYNAMICS.VW_D365_TAXDECLARATION_PILOT_REQUESTS_DEV', if(equals(pipeline().parameters.PipelineId, 'D365_FUNDRAISINGPAGE_PILOT'), 'INTEGRATION_DB.DYNAMICS.VW_D365_FUNDRAISINGPAGE_PILOT_REQUESTS_DEV', if(equals(pipeline().parameters.PipelineId, 'D365_MEMBERSHIPCATEGORY_PILOT'), 'INTEGRATION_DB.DYNAMICS.VW_D365_MEMBERSHIPCATEGORY_PILOT_REQUESTS_DEV', if(equals(pipeline().parameters.PipelineId, 'D365_EVENTPARTICIPANT_PILOT'), 'INTEGRATION_DB.DYNAMICS.VW_D365_EVENTPARTICIPANT_PILOT_REQUESTS_DEV', if(equals(pipeline().parameters.PipelineId, 'D365_EVENTSUBCATEGORY_PILOT'), 'INTEGRATION_DB.DYNAMICS.VW_D365_EVENTSUBCATEGORY_PILOT_REQUESTS_DEV', if(equals(pipeline().parameters.PipelineId, 'D365_EVENT_BATCH'), 'INTEGRATION_DB.DYNAMICS.VW_D365_EVENT_BATCH_REQUESTS_DEV', if(equals(pipeline().parameters.PipelineId, 'D365_EVENT_PILOT'), 'INTEGRATION_DB.DYNAMICS.VW_D365_EVENT_PILOT_REQUESTS_DEV', if(equals(pipeline().parameters.PipelineId, 'D365_EVENTTYPE_BATCH'), 'INTEGRATION_DB.DYNAMICS.VW_D365_EVENTTYPE_BATCH_REQUESTS_DEV', if(equals(pipeline().parameters.PipelineId, 'D365_EVENTTYPE_PILOT'), 'INTEGRATION_DB.DYNAMICS.VW_D365_EVENTTYPE_PILOT_REQUESTS_DEV', 'INTEGRATION_DB.DYNAMICS.VW_D365_REQUESTS'))))))))))))) }
WHERE pipeline_id = '@{pipeline().parameters.PipelineId}'
    AND source_instance = '@{pipeline().parameters.SourceInstance}'
    AND entity_id = '@{pipeline().parameters.EntityId}'@{if(equals(pipeline().parameters.PipelineId, 'D365_EVENT_BATCH'), concat('
    AND http_method = ''POST''
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY GOLDEN_RECORD_ID) <= LEAST(', if(greater(pipeline().parameters.TestRowsPerCombo, 0), string(pipeline().parameters.TestRowsPerCombo), '1'), ', 2000)'), if(equals(pipeline().parameters.PipelineId, 'D365_EVENTTYPE_BATCH'), '
    AND http_method = ''POST''
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY GOLDEN_RECORD_ID) = 1', if(greater(pipeline().parameters.TestRowsPerCombo, 0), concat('
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY HTTP_METHOD ORDER BY GOLDEN_RECORD_ID) <= ', string(pipeline().parameters.TestRowsPerCombo)), '')))}

activities.name: FE_ApiRequests
activities.description: Iterates over each pending request row. Non-sequential with batchCount 5, bounded by Dataverse's 52-concurrent-request service-protection limit. Each iteration calls IF_PostOrPatch to dispatch the correct HTTP verb; ADF acquires a Dataverse token per call using the factory managed identity.

activities.name: IF_PostOrPatch
activities.description: Branches on HTTP_METHOD: POST to create a new row, PATCH to update an existing row. This logic is entity-agnostic (Contact, Account, and Connection can all pass through if present in VW_D365_REQUESTS).

ifFalseActivities.name: WEB_Patch
ifFalseActivities.description: Updates an existing contact/account via PATCH. Authenticates via managed identity against the Dataverse resource.

ifFalseActivities.name: SCR_LogPatchSuccess
ifFalseActivities.description: Dataverse returns 204 No Content on a successful PATCH.

ifFalseActivities.name: SET_BuildPatchFailedLogSQL
ifFalseActivities.description: Builds the SP_D365_LOG_RESPONSE call as a single string via @concat, avoiding the ADF expression parser issues around mixed quoting and unmatched parens in inline @{} expressions. Uses substring(...,0,3) rather than split(...,' (') to sidestep the parser choking on the literal '(' in the split delimiter.

value.value: @concat('CALL AUDIT_DB.MONITORING.SP_D365_LOG_RESPONSE(''', item().GOLDEN_RECORD_ID, ''', ''', item().ENTITY_ID, ''', ''', item().PAYLOAD_MD5, ''', ', if(contains(activity('WEB_Patch').error.message, ' indicate success: '), substring(split(activity('WEB_Patch').error.message, ' indicate success: ')[1], 0, 3), 'NULL'), ', ''', if(contains(activity('WEB_Patch').error.message, ' indicate success: '), concat('HTTP_', substring(split(activity('WEB_Patch').error.message, ' indicate success: ')[1], 0, 3)), if(contains(toLower(string(activity('WEB_Patch').error.message)), 'timeout'), 'TIMEOUT', 'WEB_ACTIVITY_FAILED')), ''', ''', replace(string(activity('WEB_Patch').error.message), '''', ''''''), ''', ''', pipeline().RunId, ''');')

ifFalseActivities.name: SCR_LogPatchFailed
ifFalseActivities.description: Executes the CALL built in SET_BuildPatchFailedLogSQL. Parses the real HTTP status out of ADF's WebActivity failure message when present; falls back to a text heuristic otherwise.

ifTrueActivities.name: WEB_Post
ifTrueActivities.description: Creates a new Dataverse row via POST (for example Contact, Account, or Connection). Prefer: return=representation plus ?$select carries the new GUID in the response body, since WebActivity can't read response headers. Authenticates via managed identity against the Dataverse resource.

activities.name: FE_EventBatch
activities.description: Processes DEV Event requests sequentially. A live Event code check precedes each create; failures require reconciliation before another run.

activities.name: WEB_EventPreflight
activities.description: Checks the live DEV Event code before POST; an existing match is not created again.

activities.name: IF_EventNotFound
activities.description: Creates only when the live preflight found no Event with this code.

ifTrueActivities.name: SCR_CaptureEvent
ifTrueActivities.description: Captures only when the returned ID matches this request's planned ID.

activities.name: SET_ReturnVars
activities.description: Returns the row count this run attempted, so the caller's watermark reflects real activity, not a backlog re-query.
